title: Album Cover with Models and Title Bar
coreRelationships: The title bar is centrally placed in the upper third, contrasting with the warm background.
The six photographic panels form a strong horizontal band, creating a visual rhythm.
The models within the panels are individually framed, yet collectively form a unified composition.
The dark background of the photographic panels makes the models stand out.
reuseFormula: Recreate the warm brown background. Design a rounded rectangular title bar with distinct purple and blue sections. Populate the lower two-thirds with a grid of six vertical photographic panels, each featuring a unique model against a dark background, ensuring variety in pose and attire. Add a placeholder circular logo and a catalog number in the bottom section. Overlay sans-serif text for the title and subtitle, adhering to the specified case, color, and alignment.

Place a rounded rectangular bar, split horizontally into purple (top) and blue (bottom), in the upper third, centered. Below this, create a horizontal strip composed of six equally sized vertical panels with dark, near-black backgrounds. Within each panel, place a distinct model in a unique pose and outfit, ensuring they are well-lit and stand out from the dark background. Center a small circular logo below the photo strip. Place a small, light-colored catalog number in the bottom left corner, and a vertically oriented, light-colored metadata string along the left edge. · Overlay the main title text in white, all-caps, sans-serif font, centered on the purple section of the bar. Overlay the subtitle text in white, title-case, sans-serif font, centered on the blue section of the bar. Ensure the text fits within the respective bar sections without touching the rounded corners.
